c_aee6b94c.subject: holo
c_aee6b94c.quote: Hunger and cold were every traveler’s companions, after all.

c_aee6b94c.subject: holo
c_aee6b94c.quote: Holo had taken the most dangerous role of all, so the least he could do was make sure her clothes weren’t soaking wet when she returned.

c_aee6b94c.subject: holo
c_aee6b94c.quote: At first, he thought she was teasing him, but Holo’s laugh was genuine.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Yet Lawrence believed his relationship with Holo the Wisewolf to be one of money, of partners in lending and borrowing, of companions in travel, and of friends.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Yet Lawrence believed his relationship with Holo the Wisewolf to be one of money, of partners in lending and borrowing, of companions in travel, and of friends.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: It was true that some good mutton was a bargain if it meant Holo would guarantee safe travels.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: I forgot to say it earlier, but the wine we got from the master—I’ve no intention of drinking it all myself. This evening we must drink together—and enjoy that mutton, too.
c_d2187b6f.qualifier: traveling companions who share meals and conversation

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Oh, there he is. That’s my companion

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Do I look like the kind of ungrateful wolf that lets her companion face a crisis alone?

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: She’s a business partner. We’re traveling together.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Lawrence’s reply was short. His brevity was proportional to his trust in her. The closer a relationship, the less the need for lengthy contracts; the more a simple handshake suffices.
c_d2187b6f.qualifier: traveling companions who share a close, trusting bond

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: If they felt pity for this poor man whose beloved companion had been killed by wolves, the point for broaching the subject had passed.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Ah, my travel companion is tiresome beyond words!

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: She must have assumed he would be angry if she killed one of his fellow humans.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: He and his companion left the town of Poroson without so much as waiting for the noontime bells.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: He had the feeling he’d grown a bit closer to Holo.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Lawrence and his companions descended the hill and took one of the roads that ran between the fields.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: The next thing Lawrence knew, he and Holo had stopped in front of a drink stand, taking in the comedy show over some beer.
c_d2187b6f.qualifier: traveling companions who share meals and drinks

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: Lawrence felt a new sense of relief, knowing that there was someone he could rely on.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: The only reason Lawrence could keep his guard up was Holo—he trusted her implicitly, and she was still the very picture of seriousness.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: You’re my partner—and partners cooperate, do they not?

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: The wolf is Holo. My companion, I mean.

c_d2187b6f.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_d2187b6f.quote: As they walked, they approached the east gate; there were more people around now busily setting about their day.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: After settling the arrangements regarding roles and compensation with the Remelio Company, Lawrence and Holo found themselves in front of a smallish church in the eastern part of Ruvinheigen.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Yet Lawrence believed his relationship with Holo the Wisewolf to be one of money, of partners in lending and borrowing, of companions in travel, and of friends.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: It was true that some good mutton was a bargain if it meant Holo would guarantee safe travels.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: He and his companion left the town of Poroson without so much as waiting for the noontime bells.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: With a companion to partake of the fine wine and food, he had overindulged.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Even with Holo at his side, Lawrence was uneasy.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: I am Lawrence, a traveling merchant. This is my companion, Holo,

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Added to that was Holo sitting in the wagon—Holo who hated all shepherds.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Wait a moment, if you would. I’ll consult with my companion.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: As the dry sound of Enek’s footfalls reached Lawrence’s ears, Holo stirred, leaning lightly against the inside of the wagon.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: If Holo hadn’t been sleeping behind him, he would have invited her to sit in the driver’s seat.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: nothing was fishier than a person of faith traveling with a merchant, after all.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Do I look like the kind of ungrateful wolf that lets her companion face a crisis alone?

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: She’s a business partner. We’re traveling together.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: he would break his promise to accompany Holo to the northlands

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: But I suppose ’tis that same quality that lets me travel with you so easily.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Lawrence sat up, apparently awakening Holo, with whom he had shared a blanket.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Lawrence and Holo sat astride their horse; likewise, Liebert rode his.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: Lawrence and Holo were fortunate that he had been alone in the office, waiting for his employees to return.

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: We are still accomplices to smuggling. Surely you didn’t think we’d come back to take revenge on you after making off with the gold?
c_ebfa4ec1.qualifier: traveling partners and accomplices in smuggling

c_ebfa4ec1.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_ebfa4ec1.quote: First, Lawrence and Holo had to borrow changes of clothes from the Remelio Company while the dirt and blood were washed from their own clothes.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: With the neigh of a horse, the pair’s strange travels had begun.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: It was past afternoon but not yet dusk; Lawrence and Holo arrived during the busiest time of the day.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: After securing lodgings for the two of them, Lawrence trimmed his beard and set out.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: Lawrence and Holo then parted ways with Zheren and headed into the town marketplace.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: Holo nodded with a vulnerability that seemed deliberate and grabbed hold of his outstretched arm.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: If you open a shop, you won’t want to leave it. I’ll have to either travel alone or find a different companion.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: Holo smiled as though speaking with a trusted friend. Lawrence was about to reply but simply nodded his head and dashed with her toward the town in the night.
c_15e35be2.qualifier: traveling companions fleeing from pursuers in Pazzio

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: He had already informed the Milone Company about the depreciating trenni silver. They might even abandon him and Holo both.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: He realized that if Holo were a mere traveling companion, he would not be so upset, and Holo herself would not have sacrificed herself to help him escape.

c_15e35be2.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_15e35be2.quote: No, no, my companion was the cause of all this originally.

c_70cc4a7c.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_70cc4a7c.quote: Lawrence had chosen the Milone Company over the local brokerages because it would pay higher commodity prices in order to best its competitors

c_70cc4a7c.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_70cc4a7c.quote: The whole of the Milone Company went from shocked to vigilant upon Lawrence’s visit. Unsurprisingly—as Lawrence proposed that together they deal with the plot behind Zheren’s swindle.

c_70cc4a7c.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_70cc4a7c.quote: Even a week ago, this remained only a fantasy, but since Lawrence had made his deal with the Milone Company, it suddenly felt much more imminent.

c_70cc4a7c.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_70cc4a7c.quote: He had already informed the Milone Company about the depreciating trenni silver.

c_70cc4a7c.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_70cc4a7c.quote: And for that, he needed the Milone Company.

c_55a96179.subject: holo
c_55a96179.quote: I was. How is Yoitsu doing these days? Is everyone well?

c_55a96179.subject: holo
c_55a96179.quote: I was. How is Yoitsu doing these days? Is everyone well?

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: said Holo, reaching down into the corner of the wagon bed.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: The church Lawrence and Holo had stopped in housed twelve guests.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Once Lawrence had cleared the chairs and returned to Holo’s side in the middle of the hall, a man approached them.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Lawrence would never have indulged in such luxury had be been alone, but now that he was in a party of two, he decided to be generous.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: He felt like an apprentice traveling with his teacher all over again.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Lawrence and Holo arrived during the busiest time of the day.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: As they talked, they continued to move along the road with the clop-clopping of the horse’s hooves as accompaniment.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: He was followed by Holo, who jumped down from the wagon a moment later.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: But just when Lawrence was about to say “It’s done, then,” Holo—who’d been silent up until that point—tugged slightly on his sleeve.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Hearing this, Holo nodded, satisfied, and turned to her “master.” “You heard the man, master.”

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: It could be that she was able to call Zheren anytime she wanted and simply wanted to keep Lawrence and Holo at the table and ordering wine for a little while longer.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Lawrence and Holo then parted ways with Zheren and headed into the town marketplace.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: They walked up the congested bridge, Holo scurrying to keep up with Lawrence.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: He and Holo hurried to the Yorend tavern that evening and informed the barmaid that they wished to meet with Zheren.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: I’ll have to either travel alone or find a different companion.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Holo smiled as though speaking with a trusted friend. Lawrence was about to reply but simply nodded his head and dashed with her toward the town in the night.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: If we split up, you’re the one that will be caught. On my own, I won’t be caught, but you will.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: That is probably my companion, Holo. She acted as a decoy so I could make it here.
c_71c04ec4.qualifier: traveling companion and partner in business

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: He realized that if Holo were a mere traveling companion, he would not be so upset, and Holo herself would not have sacrificed herself to help him escape.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: My companion, Holo, is the wolf-god of the harvest

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Ensuring that they wouldn’t be separated, Lawrence ran.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Lawrence ignored them and continued to run, but Holo was uneasy.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: The companions’ anxiety made them imagine a great swarm of men pursuing them, more numerous than ants.
c_71c04ec4.qualifier: traveling companions fleeing from the Medio Company

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: When he realized that Holo had abandoned escape and even now had her teeth in the arm of their knife-wielding attacker, Lawrence, too, lost control.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Just a bit farther. We’ll take this passage, then turn right…” she began, taking Lawrence’s hand—but then stopped short.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: Lawrence and Holo fell silent, despairing like loan sharks looking down the long path to heaven.
c_71c04ec4.qualifier: traveling companions trapped together in a tunnel

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: As fate would have it, this strange girl I’ve picked up wishes to return to the northlands. I have a contract to accompany her there.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: When he considered that if he hadn’t gotten involved in this business, Holo might not have left him, the only figures he saw in his mind were red.

c_71c04ec4.subject: holo
c_71c04ec4.quote: It seemed as though the travels of this strange pair would last a bit longer.

c_e1515a67.subject: marheit
c_e1515a67.quote: He was entirely focused on protecting the interests of the Milone Company and extracting any available profit from the situation.
c_e1515a67.qualifier: business partner working to resolve a crisis

c_e1515a67.subject: marheit
c_e1515a67.quote: According to our contract with you, Mr. Lawrence, we owe you five percent of our profit. Is that correct?

c_1bef3c92.subject: zheren
c_1bef3c92.quote: Hmm…but if that’s true, it’s reasonable to assume that Zheren was lying all along,” said Lawrence.

c_1bef3c92.subject: zheren
c_1bef3c92.quote: Unsurprisingly—as Lawrence proposed that together they deal with the plot behind Zheren’s swindle.

c_39f77bc0.subject: yarei
c_39f77bc0.quote: What are you doing! Hurry, take them!” Yarei shouted, and the Medio henchmen—whose advance had been stalled by Holo’s strange actions—regained their senses and began to close in.

c_39f77bc0.subject: yarei
c_39f77bc0.quote: The image of Yarei’s torso in Holo’s fangs came unbidden to Lawrence’s mind. It was unthinkable that Yarei could escape. He was a bird with no chance to avoid the hound’s attack.

c_ba86db98.subject: weiz
c_ba86db98.quote: The association between the two professionals had been long. It was like a friendship, formed not out of kindness but necessity.
c_ba86db98.qualifier: long-term professional association based on necessity

c_ba86db98.subject: weiz
c_ba86db98.quote: Well, watch yourself, friend. ’Tisn’t so easy to get ahead of the crowd,” said Weiz

c_00a28f47.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_00a28f47.quote: The display made Lawrence nauseous—and Liebert had planned to kill both him and the girl.
c_00a28f47.qualifier: man who attempted to kill him

c_00a28f47.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_00a28f47.quote: He was cut off when Lawrence punched him in the nose.
c_00a28f47.qualifier: punched him in the nose and rejected his attempt to equate them as merchants

c_2c6d6f4a.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_2c6d6f4a.quote: With Norah leading the way as she guided her seven sheep and her sheepdog Enek, the group headed northeast to the town of Lamtra.

c_2c6d6f4a.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_2c6d6f4a.quote: That person was supposed to have been Liebert, but he lay there snoring away, firewood clasped in his arms.

c_2c6d6f4a.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_2c6d6f4a.quote: On the far side of the ferns and undergrowth beneath the trees, Lawrence and the others ran side by side.

c_3f0f5065.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_3f0f5065.quote: Still, this is the first time I’ve had a shepherd offer their services as an escort.

c_3f0f5065.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_3f0f5065.quote: Lawrence and his companions descended the hill and took one of the roads that ran between the fields.

c_3f0f5065.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_3f0f5065.quote: Lawrence was still uneasy about it, but Norah was with them, and she had made the trek many times and never been attacked once.
c_3f0f5065.qualifier: traveling companion for a smuggling operation

c_3f0f5065.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_3f0f5065.quote: On the far side of the ferns and undergrowth beneath the trees, Lawrence and the others ran side by side.

c_3f0f5065.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_3f0f5065.quote: his enemies plotted the murder of the girl he himself had hired.
c_3f0f5065.qualifier: business associate in a smuggling operation

c_aa750733.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_aa750733.quote: the Remelio Company was trying to force Lawrence to pay up

c_aa750733.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_aa750733.quote: The Remelio Company clearly assumed that Lawrence planned to blackmail them.
c_aa750733.qualifier: betrayed by the company to eliminate a potential blackmail threat

c_aa750733.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_aa750733.quote: Still, we’re not just saving the Remelio Company out of charity.
c_aa750733.qualifier: business rival seeking to profit from their situation

c_aa750733.subject: kraft-lawrence
c_aa750733.quote: It seemed imprudent to let Remelio see Holo’s wolf form, but he and Lawrence both shared the secret of the gold smuggling.

c_4ec7fae0.subject: holo
c_4ec7fae0.quote: Lawrence began walking with Holo at his right side and Norah to his left, trailing behind him slightly.

c_4ec7fae0.subject: holo
c_4ec7fae0.quote: Norah and Holo shook hands as well, and now all three of their fates were inextricably linked. All three would laugh together or all three would weep.
c_4ec7fae0.qualifier: allied in a shared, risky business venture

c_4ec7fae0.subject: holo
c_4ec7fae0.quote: Lawrence knew it wasn’t simply his imagination since Holo and Norah had been continuously on guard as well.

c_53a52f5f.subject: holo
c_53a52f5f.quote: Lawrence heard her and remembered that Holo had no love for shepherds.

c_53a52f5f.subject: holo
c_53a52f5f.quote: Apparently the indulgence of a wisewolf was not so broad as to forgive pleasant conversation with a hated shepherd.

c_53a52f5f.subject: holo
c_53a52f5f.quote: I am a wolf. The girl is a shepherd. We are eternal antagonists.
c_53a52f5f.qualifier: eternal antagonist as a wolf to a shepherd

c_53a52f5f.subject: holo
c_53a52f5f.quote: Holo was serious. At this rate, Norah could be killed.
c_53a52f5f.qualifier: threatening the shepherdess while in wolf form

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Holo had joined him, and the two had been traveling together since.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence laughed it off but soon realized—Holo had set out on her travels hundreds of years ago.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Still, it’s hard to give up pears,” said Holo, turning to Lawrence and looking up at him.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence was idly looking on when a tug at his sleeve pulled him out of his reverie. There was no one else there—it was Holo.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: asked the master worriedly as he and Lawrence looked to Holo, who leaned unsteadily against the wall.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence would have been happier if she’d said something sooner, but the reality was he had not noticed the fraud, and the fact that Holo did had turned a great loss into a great gain.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: This is why Lawrence decided that with Holo along, he would risk traveling the plains, despite the rumors of wolves.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence could guess that much without asking Holo, but he went ahead and consulted her anyway.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence was teaching her the names of various currencies as a way to combat boredom, but even Holo the Wisewolf struggled with coins whose size and design were so similar.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: She had constantly gotten the best of him since they’d met, and he realized he was generally used to her treatment.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: I am Lawrence, a traveling merchant. This is my companion, Holo,

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: The moment the thought crossed his mind, though, Holo stirred; Lawrence spoke up hastily. “Uh, er, so, speaking strictly from the standpoint of a merchant, you might make more money escorting my kind like this than you do tending sheep.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: As Norah turned aside to work with Enek, Lawrence looked at Holo, who had been feigning sleep. Holo returned his gaze, then she sniffed and turned away, shutting her eyes.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: When he looked away from her, his eyes landed on Holo, who was at his right.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence moved to get off the wagon, but Holo grabbed his sleeve and drew near.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: nothing was fishier than a person of faith traveling with a merchant, after all.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: It won’t do to get separated. May I take your hand?

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: The dockmaster had apparently been informed of the situation in advance, so he silently watched Lawrence and Holo leave.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Do I look like the kind of ungrateful wolf that lets her companion face a crisis alone?

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: She’s a business partner. We’re traveling together.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: At this rate, he would break his promise to accompany Holo to the northlands.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: After Lawrence met back up with Holo, who waited outside the row of companies and mansions, he didn’t bother with a fifth rendition of that same line.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Then he realized that Holo had felt the same pain when he struck her hand. Lawrence had been prepared for this reaction, whereas his rejection of Holo came utterly without warning.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Though it was only a verbal contract, Lawrence had promised to take her to the northlands, and parting on such bad terms would leave a bad taste in his mouth.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: After taking breakfast at a stall, Lawrence and Holo headed on foot to the Remelio Company.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: The only reason he didn’t deny Lawrence and Holo on the spot was that he had just enough funds to finance the plan.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: After settling the arrangements regarding roles and compensation with the Remelio Company, Lawrence and Holo found themselves in front of a smallish church in the eastern part of Ruvinheigen.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: It’s thanks to that softheartedness that I’ve been able to travel so easily

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence began walking with Holo at his right side and Norah to his left, trailing behind him slightly.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Still, neither humans nor wolves can live alone. Sometimes one needs a pack mate to curl up with. Am I wrong?
c_b49dfd85.qualifier: traveling companions who share a pack-like bond

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence. And this is my companion, Holo.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Holo tugged at Lawrence’s sleeve once she had finished teasing the poor lamb.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: In the first place, ’tis not strange to ask if someone like me, traveling alone with a man, knows a lot about wolves!

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: You’re my partner—and partners cooperate, do they not?

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Holo watched all this, then turned to Lawrence.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: This was true of Lawrence himself as well, of course, and once he reunited with Holo, he had the hope of exacting as much retribution as he wanted.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Has my companion been so foolish as to trip and fall?

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: The wolf is Holo. My companion, I mean.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: After they walked for a while, Lawrence starting thinking about riding on Holo’s back, but she had apparently already anticipated that and spoke up just in time to cut him off.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: Lawrence and Holo were fortunate that he had been alone in the office

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: First, Lawrence and Holo had to borrow changes of clothes from the Remelio Company while the dirt and blood were washed from their own clothes.

c_b49dfd85.subject: holo
c_b49dfd85.quote: As they walked, they approached the east gate; there were more people around now busily setting about their day.

c_c4a9a8f8.subject: holo
c_c4a9a8f8.quote: Holo, surprised, caught Lawrence as he toppled.

c_c4a9a8f8.subject: holo
c_c4a9a8f8.quote: Yet Lawrence could neither praise the feat as amazing nor give his thanks to Holo for saving them.

c_6dfc7b44.subject: norah-arendt
c_6dfc7b44.quote: Liebert was the man Hans Remelio had entrusted with the role of smuggling in the gold. Lawrence had no objection, and of course, neither Norah nor Holo seemed opposed.

c_6dfc7b44.subject: norah-arendt
c_6dfc7b44.quote: There in the stillness, Norah and Liebert did not seem to take notice of Holo and Lawrence’s exchange as they glared unblinkingly into the forest.
c_6dfc7b44.qualifier: traveling together and watching the forest

c_6dfc7b44.subject: norah-arendt
c_6dfc7b44.quote: Lawrence hadn’t planned to shout, but Norah and Liebert snapped out of their reveries as though they had heard voices in the middle of the night.

c_6dfc7b44.subject: norah-arendt
c_6dfc7b44.quote: It appeared that Norah and Liebert had traveled some distance ahead in a short time.

c_6dfc7b44.subject: norah-arendt
c_6dfc7b44.quote: Norah and Liebert had probably already cleared the edge of the forest and were making their way straight to Ruvinheigen.

c_7372edec.subject: norah-arendt
c_7372edec.quote: The Remelio Company plans to murder Norah.

c_7372edec.subject: norah-arendt
c_7372edec.quote: The Remelio Company had planned to kill you, Norah. I swear this to you—they betrayed us.
c_7372edec.qualifier: The Remelio Company had planned to kill Norah

c_81848e1c.subject: norah-arendt
c_81848e1c.quote: Apparently the indulgence of a wisewolf was not so broad as to forgive pleasant conversation with a hated shepherd.

c_81848e1c.subject: norah-arendt
c_81848e1c.quote: If Norah took Holo for an enemy and protected Liebert and company, she would be spared no mercy, in other words.
c_81848e1c.qualifier: potential adversary in a conflict involving Liebert and company

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: The road that Lawrence and his companions took was evidently less traveled as their checkpoint—while not exactly crude—was rather simpler than checkpoints on more common routes, and the guard there seemed to know Norah.

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: I want to hire you for a certain job. Compensation will be twenty lumione.
c_93501446.qualifier: hired shepherdess for a dangerous job

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: Norah and Holo shook hands as well, and now all three of their fates were inextricably linked.
c_93501446.qualifier: business partners in a gold smuggling scheme

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: Thus, Norah picked up her sheep from the church right after morning services, then headed immediately to join up with the others.

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: The shepherdess before him was the one who would be in the most danger when they moved the gold.
c_93501446.qualifier: traveling companion for a smuggling job

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: But in their hearts, they will bear a grudge against three demons—that is to say, me, Holo, and you, Norah.
c_93501446.qualifier: traveling partners in a business arrangement involving gold smuggling

c_93501446.subject: norah-arendt
c_93501446.quote: Lawrence ignored her and waved broadly three times just as when he had first met Norah on the road.

c_939ae632.subject: norah-arendt
c_939ae632.quote: Norah and Holo shook hands as well, and now all three of their fates were inextricably linked.
c_939ae632.qualifier: business partners in a gold smuggling scheme

c_939ae632.subject: norah-arendt
c_939ae632.quote: Liebert was the man Hans Remelio had entrusted with the role of smuggling in the gold. Lawrence had no objection, and of course, neither Norah nor Holo seemed opposed.

c_939ae632.subject: norah-arendt
c_939ae632.quote: Lawrence had noticed Norah trying to engage her female companion several times, but Holo’s curtness made her hesitate.

c_939ae632.subject: norah-arendt
c_939ae632.quote: Norah gave Holo a look more eloquent than words and then soon turned away.

c_939ae632.subject: norah-arendt
c_939ae632.quote: But in their hearts, they will bear a grudge against three demons—that is to say, me, Holo, and you, Norah.
c_939ae632.qualifier: traveling partners in a business arrangement involving gold smuggling

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: Norah headed up the group along with Liebert on horseback; behind them came the seven sheep; and trailing the sheep was Lawrence, leading the horse on which Holo rode.
c_11d8918a.qualifier: traveling together as part of the same group

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: Norah was absorbed in her own work, ringing the bell on her staff and directing Enek, rounding up the sleeping sheep and bringing them closer to the campfire, and then tapping the sleeping Liebert on the shoulder.
c_11d8918a.qualifier: traveling companion in the same camp

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: The small band headed back onto the narrow path between forest and hills.
c_11d8918a.qualifier: member of a small band smuggling sheep

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: There in the stillness, Norah and Liebert did not seem to take notice of Holo and Lawrence’s exchange as they glared unblinkingly into the forest.
c_11d8918a.qualifier: traveling companions watching the forest together

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: Lawrence hadn’t planned to shout, but Norah and Liebert snapped out of their reveries as though they had heard voices in the middle of the night.

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: It appeared that Norah and Liebert had traveled some distance ahead in a short time.

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: Norah and Liebert had probably already cleared the edge of the forest and were making their way straight to Ruvinheigen.
c_11d8918a.qualifier: traveling together to Ruvinheigen to smuggle gold

c_11d8918a.subject: liebert
c_11d8918a.quote: If Norah and Liebert ran through the night, they might make it through the checkpoint to Ruvinheigen before dawn.

c_1a65770a.subject: liebert
c_1a65770a.quote: Liebert was the man Hans Remelio had entrusted with the role of smuggling in the gold. Lawrence had no objection
c_1a65770a.qualifier: traveling companion for a gold smuggling mission

c_1a65770a.subject: liebert
c_1a65770a.quote: In contrast to that, if Liebert and Lawrence were to keep silent, they might be able make it through the checkpoint.
c_1a65770a.qualifier: business associate involved in a gold smuggling scheme

c_1a65770a.subject: liebert
c_1a65770a.quote: The small band headed back onto the narrow path between forest and hills.
c_1a65770a.qualifier: member of a small band smuggling sheep

c_1a65770a.subject: liebert
c_1a65770a.quote: On the far side of the ferns and undergrowth beneath the trees, Lawrence and the others ran side by side. Lawrence and Holo sat astride their horse; likewise, Liebert rode his.
c_1a65770a.qualifier: traveling together on horseback while fleeing from wolves

c_789c1dd7.subject: liebert
c_789c1dd7.quote: If Norah took Holo for an enemy and protected Liebert and company, she would be spared no mercy, in other words.
c_789c1dd7.qualifier: Holo considers Liebert and his company a nuisance whose lives she will not guarantee

c_789c1dd7.subject: liebert
c_789c1dd7.quote: Immediately upon landing, Holo sprung forward after the fleeing Liebert, whose desire for money had reduced him to a swine.
c_789c1dd7.qualifier: pursued by Holo after attempting to steal money

c_9f1203ad.subject: liebert
c_9f1203ad.quote: In that case, there was a risk that Liebert would kill Norah, so could Holo explain that she was only there for the Remelio men?
c_9f1203ad.qualifier: would kill her if she tried to protect others from a wolf attack

c_9f1203ad.subject: liebert
c_9f1203ad.quote: The display made Lawrence nauseous—and Liebert had planned to kill both him and the girl.
c_9f1203ad.qualifier: betrayer who planned to kill her

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: My name is Marten Liebert, of the Remelio Company.

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: The young employee of the Remelio Company paled at Norah’s words

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: We heard from Mr. Liebert—we couldn’t just stay at the company—so we came out and waited at the edge of the forest.

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: Despite the resolute orders and the brave attempts of some Remelio men to carry them out, in the face of an attack by Holo obviously designed to smash their hopes, many of the men cried out and took flight.

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: It—it wasn’t me! It was Remelio’s orders. I told him not to do it. I told him betrayal would call down God’s wrath. I swear, I was against it—

c_a80be9c9.subject: liebert
c_a80be9c9.quote: If Liebert is to be believed, it’s worth six hundred lumione.
c_a80be9c9.qualifier: source of information regarding gold value

c_6702ee38.subject: jakob
c_6702ee38.quote: As the master of the Ruvinheigen branch of the Rowen Trade Guild, Jakob had to confront Lawrence with harsh reality

c_6702ee38.subject: jakob
c_6702ee38.quote: Lawrence was greeted heartily by the members of the trade guild, who had gathered there to drink after the end of the business day. He endured many vulgar questions about the wound on his face before finally reaching Jakob.

c_f3aa564a.subject: jakob
c_f3aa564a.quote: Jakob trusted Lawrence enough to give him his freedom for two days.
c_f3aa564a.qualifier: trusted him enough to grant him two days of freedom

c_f3aa564a.subject: jakob
c_f3aa564a.quote: But then his face split in a tearful smile, and he threw his arms wide, relieved that Lawrence was safe.

c_6975bd97.subject: weiz
c_6975bd97.quote: As he approached the shepherdess to receive her prayer, he thought of Weiz, the money changer in Pazzio, and envied him his easy way with women.

c_6975bd97.subject: weiz
c_6975bd97.quote: At such times, he was unable to muster his usual disdain for Weiz, the womanizing money changer in the port town of Pazzio.

source_observations.quote: Hmm…but if that’s true, it’s reasonable to assume that Zheren was lying all along,” said Lawrence.

source_observations.subject: zheren
source_observations.quote: Unsurprisingly—as Lawrence proposed that together they deal with the plot behind Zheren’s swindle.

polarity_group_dispositions.recommended_shadow_projection: Keep the possible sample as history and publish the later asserted appearance.

source_observations.subject: holo
source_observations.quote: Her body grew up and out rapidly to the sound of tearing fabric, brown fur nearly exploding through it.

polarity_group_dispositions.recommended_shadow_projection: Reject the later observation and retain the directly evidenced alive assertion.

source_observations.subject: holo
source_observations.quote: But there was something important the men had overlooked. They thought Holo was dead.
